Grammar/linguistic point: verb_reduplication
Verb reduplication (V.V., e.g. 玩玩, 想想) used for light/tentative requests or plans.
Examples (original -> corrected, why):

## Grammar Corrections
- 孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩：有一个叫孟子的小孩子，他从早到晚都跟朋友玩，A main character should be briefly introduced by name and role at the first mention.
- 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A place phrase normally comes before the action verb it modifies.
- 装祭拜：假装祭拜，装 does not naturally take this verbal action directly; use 假装 before a verb to express pretending to do an action.

## Vocabulary Suggestions
- 从早到晚 -- “从早到晚都跟朋友玩”：一整天，This is a common alternative that simply emphasizes the whole day；天天，This means every day rather than the time span within one day.
- 朋友 -- “跟朋友玩”：小伙伴，This is a warm, childlike word for friends who play together；同学，This specifically means classmates and fits only if they attend the same school.
- 喜欢 -- “喜欢在墓地里玩”：爱，This is a stronger everyday word for liking something very much；想，This emphasizes wanting to do something at a particular time.
- 玩 -- “在墓地里玩”：玩耍，This has the same basic meaning but sounds a little more formal in writing；一起玩，This makes the shared activity with friends more explicit.
- 搬家 -- “跟妈妈搬家”：搬到别的地方，This clearly states that they moved to another place；换地方住，This is a very everyday way to describe changing homes.
- 认为 -- “妈妈认为”：觉得，This is a more conversational word for having an opinion or feeling；想，This is simpler and can express what someone thinks.
- 太近 -- “离墓地太近”：很近，This describes short distance without the strong “too” meaning；离墓地不远，This means the home is not far from the cemetery.

## Encouragement
You used clear cause-and-effect structure with “不是……而是因为……,” and the final sentence explains the reason for the move very clearly. Your story also has a logical sequence: playing, moving house, and explaining why.

## Grammar Corrections
- 住离墓地太近：住得离墓地太近，A verb followed by an adjective phrase of degree uses 得, so 住得离墓地太近 expresses that the home is excessively close to the cemetery.
- 害得孟子的心气：影响孟子的心情，害得 needs to introduce a resulting state or description after the affected person; 影响 can directly take the affected feeling as its object.

## Vocabulary Suggestions
- 妈妈 -- “妈妈认为”：觉得，a very common alternative that sounds slightly more conversational when giving an opinion；母亲，a more formal alternative often used in narration.
- 认为 -- “妈妈认为”：觉得，an everyday word for a personal opinion；想，a simpler choice that can express what someone believes or thinks.
- 墓地 -- “离墓地太近”：坟地，a common everyday synonym for a burial place；墓园，a slightly more neutral word for an organized cemetery.
- 搬到 -- “搬到子思老师的家”：搬去，an everyday alternative that emphasizes going to the new place；迁到，a somewhat more formal word often used for moving residence.
- 打扫 -- “打扫房间”：收拾，an everyday word that can include tidying objects as well as cleaning；清理，a useful alternative when removing dirt or unwanted things.
- 帮 -- “子思帮孟母”：帮助，a slightly more formal version of the same meaning；帮忙，an everyday choice that emphasizes doing a favor or assisting with a task.
- 读书 -- “他老是读书”：看书，an everyday alternative that emphasizes reading books；学习，a broader word that can include reading, practicing, and doing schoolwork.
- 老是 -- “他老是读书”：一直，a neutral word for continuing over time；常常，a neutral word for doing something frequently, without the mildly complaining tone that 老是 can have.

  - 孟子才十一岁，成为一个哲学家 -> 就成为  [才Num.就V.]
  - 才二十岁，孟子成为很厉害的哲学家 -> 就成为  [才Num.就V.]
  - 才九岁，他想找工作 -> delete他，add就，才Num.就V.

### Rule: time_expression
Grammar/linguistic point: time_expression
Time expressions: 在古代 (not 古代的时候), 后来 vs. 以后 vs. 将来, 长大以后, Time + 以后; 'then' in a narrative is 然后/后来, not 以后 alone.
Examples (original -> corrected, why):
  - 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住在一起 -> 在古代  [better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears]
  - 很多年的时候，他测试别的植物 -> 他尝试各种植物尝试了很多年  [“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”]
  - 秋季期间 not very natural -> 整个秋季期间；Time + 期间：usually special, long period, “秋季” itself is not “special” enough, “整个/今年秋季” would highlight this particular, special period.
  - 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家 -> 在古代  [better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place]
  - 他以后正好看一个灵芝，他一吃灵芝就身体好了 -> 然后  [Time+以后；他正好看到，看look vs.看到see; 身体就好了，Subj. + 就]
  - 他是大人的时候，他成为很有名的哲人 -> 长大以后，哲学家  [delete the first他]
  - 以后他知道灵芝没有毒，夹竹桃有毒，它可以做药 -> 后来  [Time+以后；“它“ is unclear, it seems that it refers to夹竹桃，which is a poison, not a medicine]
  - 在古代时候，孟子跟他妈妈常常搬家 -> 在古代  [better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears]

### Rule: laoshi_negative_connotation
Grammar/linguistic point: laoshi_negative_connotation
老是 ('always/keeps on') carries a negative, complaining connotation -- wrong when the sentence is neutral/positive.
Examples (original -> corrected, why):
  - 在新的地方，孟子跟老师老是学习中文 -> 一直学习中文  [“老是“ for something negative, used to complain]
  - 所以孟子老是在学习 -> 一直  [“老是“ for something negative, used to complain]
  - 他写汉字老是写得很好 -> 一直  [“老是“ for something negative, used to complain]
  - 他们搬家安静以后，孟子从早到晚老是学哲学 -> 搬到安静的地方以后，一直  [“老是“ for something negative, used to complain]
  - 他说他老是来墓地请祖先给他建议 -> 常常  [“老是“ for something negative, used to complain]
  - 他从童年老是讨论重要的生活问题，很幸福 -> 从童年开始，一直  [“老是“ for something negative, used to complain]
  - 孟母老是搬家，所以孟子会跟别的教授学哲学 -> “老是“ for something negative, used to complain；这样in this way
  - 他认为没做过祭拜的孩子的父母老是死了 -> 没祭拜过的孩子会失去父母  [“老是“ means always, ”死” cannot be done multiple times]

### Rule: aspect_zai_progressive
Grammar/linguistic point: aspect_zai_progressive
在/正在 + V. marks an ongoing action (一直在学习); do not add 在 when the action is not ongoing.
Examples (original -> corrected, why):
  - 搬家十年，孟子一直学了很多东西，孟子每个地方才住了一年 -> 在搬家的十年里；一直在学习  [一直在+V., emphasizing always ongoing；replace the second孟子with他]
  - 神农在新鲜空气的山走路看到几种的植物，也看到了很多人吃植物 -> 在空气新鲜的山里走路，很多人在吃植物  [在ongoing]
  - 而是因为住在那里以后孟子一直在没读书 -> 一直没在读书
  - 他一直都吃了，他连毒都能吃 -> 一直都在吃不同的植物；delete the second他
  - 孟子不是在看商店的员工，就是在跟其他的孩子玩商店的游戏 -> delete the two在，here is not emphasizing “ongoing”

## Grammar Corrections
- 孟子从五岁一直学哲学：孟子从五岁起一直学哲学，when a starting age is introduced with 从, add 起 or 开始 to mark the starting point clearly.

## Vocabulary Suggestions
- 认为 -- “子思认为”：觉得，a more conversational way to state an opinion；以为，often introduces a personal belief and can sometimes imply that the belief was later shown to be mistaken.
- 孩子 -- “对孩子来说”：小孩，an equally common, more everyday term for young children；儿童，a slightly more formal term, often used in general statements.
- 读书 -- “读书最重要”：学习，broader than reading and can include many kinds of study；看书，focuses specifically on reading books.
- 特别 -- “特别是学哲学”：尤其，an equally natural choice that gives extra emphasis to the following example；最重要的是，puts stronger focus on the main point.
- 练习 -- “练习写文章”：学习，emphasizes learning the skill rather than repeating practice；写作，refers specifically to the activity or skill of writing articles.
- 有名 -- “很有名的哲学家”：出名，a common everyday alternative meaning “well-known”；著名，a slightly more formal word for someone widely known.

## Encouragement
You used the “不是……就是……” structure correctly to show that Mencius spent his time on two study activities. Your final sentence also uses “才五岁就……” naturally to emphasize how early he began learning philosophy.

prompt.system:
You are a Chinese-language writing tutor giving end-of-story feedback to an early learner who has just finished writing a short narrative scene by scene. Grammar, vocabulary, and coherence have ALREADY been covered scene by scene -- do NOT comment on them here. Assess only the overall CONTENT and COMPLETENESS of the story as a whole.

Rules:
1. Judge the whole story: does it have enough scenes and events to be a complete story -- a beginning that introduces the characters and setting, a middle with the main events, and an ending that resolves them? Are there gaps where a reader would not understand what happened or why?
2. Only flag real gaps. Do not invent problems; if a part is already complete, do not list it as an item.
3. Point to specific scenes ("Scene 2") when you flag a gap, and say concretely what is missing.
4. Write ALL prose in English. Chinese appears only in short quoted spans or small example phrases at the student's own level.
5. Be encouraging and concise -- this is an early learner.

Output format -- Markdown, exactly this structure:

## Content & Completeness
- one missing, unclear, or underdeveloped part of the story per line, naming the scene and what the story needs
- (if the story is complete, write exactly "- Nothing to flag.")

## Overall Encouragement
One or two sentences on what the student did well across the whole story.

Keep each "## " heading on its own line exactly as written, and put every item on its own line beginning with "- ".
